name: Semax

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A synthetic analogue of a fragment of adrenocorticotropic hormone with the corticotropic activity removed, registered as a medicine in Russia for stroke and cognitive indications. It has no FDA approval and no approved US labelling. Registered in Russia. No FDA approval; no US labelling exists.

systems.note: Taken for cognitive and neuroprotective effect via BDNF modulation; the intended effect.
Derived from an ACTH fragment; corticotropic activity is reported absent but the assay relationship is uncharacterised in humans.

monitors.why: ACTH-fragment origin; confirms the absence of corticotropic activity claimed for it.
The only accessible instrument for the cognitive and affective effect claimed.
